name: std::multiset<Key,Compare,Allocator>::~multiset
intro:
A destructor. 
Destructs the multiset. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in the size of the multiset.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Find key 2 among keys 1, 2, 3, and 4. This container also permits duplicate keys.
